_readme: Rename this file to ai-analysis.json (and remove this _readme key) to enable it. Keyed by the Google Sheet row number (as text). Each entry supplies the fields that Column AH/AI PDF analysis produces, since app.js cannot read PDFs or call an AI model at runtime — see README.md, section 'AI-analyzed fields (optional)'. This example uses a fictional row/petitioner only; do not commit real petitioner data (names, Aadhaar, mobile, PDF links) to a public repository.

2.fieldEnquiryReport: Example: field enquiry on <date> confirmed the petitioner's possession of the land in question; no encroachment found; measurements match the FMB sketch.
2.personsAttended: Example: Village Revenue Officer, Village Surveyor, Petitioner
2.remarksTahsildar: Example: recommended for mutation based on field enquiry findings.
